trigger.description: A machine response exceeds the --max-output-tokens ceiling and either its schema declares no truncation point in the output-governor registry, or even the envelope minimum (one kept element) still exceeds the ceiling. The response fails closed (ADR 0063 §2): the envelope shell and identifying data.command/data.schema fields are kept, the oversized payload is withheld, and the degraded entry's repair names the estimated ceiling that would satisfy the request. No special cases, no exemptions — a schema that cannot declare a clean point needs redesign, not a carve-out.
